name: Waterfall.io
description: A B2B data enrichment API that aggregates 30+ vendors to find and verify contact emails, phone numbers, company data, and job changes for GTM/RevOps teams.
gating_notes: No public self-serve signup or free trial found. The marketing site's onboarding flow is 'Book a call' → free data benchmark → custom pricing, explicitly stating 'Before anything is signed we run a benchmark on your data at no cost' and 'From first call to live integration in 1 day.' Docs describe the x-api-key auth mechanism and API key management but never document a self-serve signup/key-issuance page.
mcp_notes: none found — search turned up only unrelated third-party projects (an Apify 'Work Email Waterfall' actor and an unrelated 'Waterfall' issue-tracker MCP server), not anything from waterfall.io itself
blocker: API access is sales/benchmark-gated (no public self-serve API key or trial), so Composio could build the toolkit technically (REST API with ~14 documented endpoints: Prospector, Contact/Phone/Company Enrichment, Search Contact, Email Verification, Job Change Detection, Company Reveal, etc.) but each end user would need to go through Waterfall's sales/benchmark process to obtain credentials before the toolkit is usable.
